title: Open redirect through the login next parameter
exploit_scenario: Send a user a link to the login page with next=https://attacker.example/login; after a real sign-in the dashboard redirects them to the attacker's copy of the page.
recommendation: Accept only paths that start with a single / and reject scheme-relative and backslash forms.

title: No rate limit on POST /login
exploit_scenario: Script unlimited POST /login attempts for a known email; nothing slows or blocks them.
recommendation: Limit attempts per IP and per email and return 429.

title: Rejected API keys are logged in plain text
exploit_scenario: Send a valid key with a scheme other than 'Bearer ' (for example 'Authorization: bearer <key>' or the bare key): CutPrefix fails, the full header value is logged by log.Printf, and anyone with log access reads a working API key.
recommendation: Never log the credential; log a short hash prefix or nothing, and parse the scheme case-insensitively.
